english.title: Breach a sexual risk order / interim sexual risk order
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse,

(A)_[did something, namely,**(..SPECIFY THING DONE..), which you were prohibited from doing]_
(B)_[failed to do something, namely **(..SPECIFY THING NOT DONE..), which was something that you were required to do]_

by

(C)_[a sexual risk order made under section 122A]_
(D)_[an interim sexual risk order made under section 122E]_

of the Sexual Offences Act 2003 by **(..SPECIFY COURT..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF ORDER OR INTERIM ORDER..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 122H(A1) and (3) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without reasonable excuse
did anything prohibited by OR
failed to do something required by
sexual risk order / interim sexual risk order

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) It is not open to the court by or before which the person is convicted to make, in respect of the offence, an order for conditional discharge - section 122H(4).
(ii) For the version of this offence in force before 29th November 2022 see offence H11485.
